qa_pair.question: Search the WebStaffr repository for all SQL queries that check tenant_id in WHERE clauses. How many files contain this pattern? What's the path to the most recent one based on git commit date?
List all open issues in the WebStaffr repository. What is the title of the oldest open issue (by creation date)?
Get the last 5 commits to the main branch of WebStaffr4.0. Who authored the most recent commit? What was their commit message?
Find all Python test files in the WebStaffr repository. How many files match the pattern 'test_*.py'? List the first 3 file paths.
Search for the Protocol class import pattern across WebStaffr codebase (look for 'from typing import Protocol' or similar). How many files use this pattern? In which module is it defined?
List all open pull requests on WebStaffr4.0 labeled with 'ready-for-review'. What are their PR numbers?
Find all files in the webstaffr/workers directory. How many Python files are in that directory? What's the path to the main worker file?
Search for all instances of the 'Null*' pattern in the codebase (NullIntegration, NullWorker, etc). How many distinct null-pattern classes are there? What are their names?
Get commit information for the 'develop' branch. What's the most recent commit SHA on that branch? When was it authored?
Search for all database error handling patterns (look for 'DB_ERRORS' or 'database' patterns). How many files reference the error handling mechanism? What module is DB_ERRORS defined in?
